abstract: Bony metastasis is common in patients with germ cell tumor of the testicle; however, it is usually seen late in the disease process and is associated with lymph node or other visceral involvement. We present a case of isolated bony metastasis in a patient with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis and normal retroperitoneal lymph nodes as determined by surgical resection.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者では骨転移は一般的であるが、通常は病期の後期に出現し、リンパ節や他の内臓病変を伴う。我々は、精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、孤立性の骨転移を認め、外科的切除で後腹膜リンパ節は正常であった症例を報告する。
